title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Penalty Schedule Within a Reinstated Fraud Plan
content:
On a fraud overpayment among Benefit Overpayment Accounts with penalty standing unpaid, the reinstated installment of a repayment plan spreads the penalty over its own shorter schedule.

| Overpayment | Monthly amount before rounding |
|---|---|
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense with penalty standing unpaid | The unpaid penalty divided by 12 (the first-offense penalty months), plus the rest of the balance divided by the reinstatement months |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense with penalty standing unpaid | The unpaid penalty divided by 6 (the repeat-offense penalty months), plus the rest of the balance divided by the reinstatement months |
| Any other overpayment, including a fraud overpayment with no penalty standing unpaid | The whole balance divided by the reinstatement months |

The rest of the balance is the balance less the penalty standing unpaid. On a fraud overpayment the two parts are added, and their sum is the monthly amount that is then rounded up to the cent.

**Penalty standing unpaid.** The penalty assessed less the penalty recovered by repayments, benefit offsets and tax refund intercepts, plus the penalty put back by returned repayments.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A Fraud Overpayment — First Offense account with a balance due of USD 1,500.00, of which USD 300.00 is penalty standing unpaid, spread over 18 reinstatement months:

| Part | Calculation | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Penalty part | USD 300.00 divided by 12 | 25.00 |
| Rest of the balance | USD 1,200.00 divided by 18 | 66.6666… |
| Sum | | 91.6666… |
| Rounded up to the cent | | USD 91.67 |

The same balance on a Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense account gives USD 300.00 divided by 6, that is 50.00, plus 66.6666…, which is 116.6666… and rounds up to USD 116.67.
